_doc: Loot Overhaul Phase 7 (lo-fate-token): the Shard of Fate. One inert token with two uses - re-roll a rolled item's random affixes at a Forge of Wonders anvil (forge_fate_go -> Loot_Reforge), or spend it on a personal bonus roll when a boss you damaged dies (loot_ondeath -> fate_open NUI). Read by bin/loot_model.py (tokens_cfg, validate_tokens) and emitted into loot_data_inc.nss as LOOTD_FATE_* by gen-loot-tables.py --apply. Decisions: admin 2026-11-05 (name, ~10% boss drop, merit shop, one bonus roll per character per boss per day) and 2026-11-06 (rolling 24 h, 3 merit, Need/Greed on drop).
